label: Facebook Marketplace Scraper
title: Facebook Marketplace Scraper: Listings, Sellers & Prices
metaDescription: Scrape Facebook Marketplace by keyword, category, city or link, no login: title, price, seller, photos, condition, vehicle and rental details.
intro: Search Facebook Marketplace by keyword, category, city or link without logging in. Every listing comes with title, price, seller, city and photo; add details for the description, condition, all photos, exact location, listing date, and vehicle or rental fields.
useCases: Track used-car prices in your city
Research rental supply and prices in an area

faq.q: Is there a Facebook Marketplace API?
faq.a: No public one. This actor searches Marketplace by keyword, category, city or link and returns each listing's title, price, location and link; add details for description, condition and all photos.

faq.q: Do I need a Facebook account?
faq.a: No. It reads what Marketplace shows to logged-out visitors, so no login or cookies are needed.

faq.q: Can I use it as a Facebook Marketplace API?
faq.a: Yes. Start a run from your own code with Apify's REST API (or the JavaScript and Python clients) and read the results as JSON; the run-sync endpoint returns the items in the same HTTP call. The same input also runs in the Apify Console, on a schedule, or from Make, Zapier and n8n.

officialApi: Meta has no public API for Facebook Marketplace listings. This actor reads the public Marketplace search results for a keyword, category and city, without logging in.
